mechanism.claim: When at least four of five inner mined-block fee-rate percentiles reprice in one direction for two consecutive twelve-hour buckets, the broad fee surface records persistent on-chain urgency rather than a one-bucket tail distortion. During high BTC variation, that persistent urgency direction should relay into BTC for one day.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of the current and previous broad fee-surface changes
mechanism.why_distinct: BFRT measured two-bucket fee-location transport while filtering tail divergence. BFWC combined fee rotation with witness composition. FSPR uses neither location/tail decomposition nor witness data: its economic object is temporal sign persistence across five fee percentiles in two consecutive transitions.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed BTC variation available at the delayed source release must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a delayed mined-block fee-surface persistence clock is absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.fee_source: hash-bound mempool.space mined-block fee-rate percentile history
features.broad_sign: strict sign shared by at least four of five nonzero transition coordinates
features.persistence: broad_sign[t] and broad_sign[t-1] exist and are identical
features.magnitude: absolute cross-sectional median of the five current transition coordinates
features.magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 valid transitions, minimum 90, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed hourly BTC log returns over 24h ending at source availability)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 valid source decisions, minimum 90, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact source available_at_utc after all fee and BTC features are complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no breadth, persistence, rank, side, hold, availability, volatility, or subset repair.
